table.name: museum
table.purpose: Catalog of museums, one row per museum, with its name, staff size, and opening year. Referenced by the visit table (visits per museum).

Museum_ID.name: Museum ID
Museum_ID.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each museum. Referenced by visit.Museum_ID (each visit is to one museum). The joins to visitor.Level_of_membership and visit.visitor_ID are likely spurious statistical coincidences given the small value range.

Name.name: Museum name
Name.description: Full name of the museum; unique per row.

Num_of_Staff.name: Number of staff
Num_of_Staff.description: Count of staff members at the museum, ranging 12–62.

Open_Year.name: Opening year
Open_Year.description: Year the museum opened (2000–2012), stored as text despite being numeric.

table.name: visit
table.purpose: Junction/fact table recording a visitor's visit to a museum: how many tickets were bought and the total amount spent. Each row is one visit by one visitor to one museum.

Museum_ID.name: Museum_ID
Museum_ID.description: Identifier of the museum visited; references museum.Museum_ID (many visits to one museum).

Num_of_Ticket.name: Num_of_Ticket
Num_of_Ticket.description: Number of tickets purchased during the visit (integer count, 2-24).

Total_spent.name: Total_spent
Total_spent.description: Total amount of money spent on the visit, presumably in the local currency (values 19.98-320.44).

visitor_ID.name: visitor_ID
visitor_ID.description: Identifier of the visitor making the visit; references visitor.ID (many visits to one visitor). The secondary join to museum.Museum_ID is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap).

table.name: visitor
table.purpose: Registry of museum visitors/members, one row per visitor, linked to visits and to a museum via membership level code that references museum.Museum_ID.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the visitor in years (values 25-56).

ID.name: Visitor ID
ID.description: Primary key identifying each visitor; referenced by visit.visitor_ID.

Level_of_membership.name: Museum ID (membership level code)
Level_of_membership.description: Despite its name, values join to museum.Museum_ID (e.g. 8 -> ZirMed Gateway Museum), so it identifies the museum the visitor is a member of, not a membership tier. The name suggests a membership level, but the accepted join and lookup pairs clearly map to museums.

Name.name: Visitor Name
Name.description: Full name of the visitor (sample values are footballer-like names, likely placeholder data).
